svg.title: N0zoM1z0 · Contribution Arcade · 14 / DUNGEON
svg.desc: 14,025 GitHub contributions across 139 active days, 2025-10-12 to 2026-10-15. Dates keep their calendar rooms. The hero plans adjacent routes to collect the smallest remaining contribution counts first; larger rooms stay dormant until their turn. Collected activity defeats a final guardian.
svg.text: 482 health guardian · activity pays for victory
